Streaming chat completion through the OpenAI-compatible endpoint of a local Ollama server, with SSE chunks

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.chat_stream(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Count to 3', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'openai/qwen2:0.5b', stream: true)).to_a
puts result.inspect
```
